task.title: Workout Logger Live Activities discovery, architecture audit, and phased implementation plan

result.summary: Research/audit/plan only; no application code. A Phase 1 Workout Logger Live Activity is feasible fully local: new Widget Extension (com.physiqueos.native.dev.WorkoutActivity), NSSupportsLiveActivities on the app, shared ActivityAttributes, no App Group, no push entitlement, no Server/HealthKit change. Authority is the persisted TrainingLoggerDraft (UserDefaults via TrainingLoggerDraftStore); the Live Activity is a write-only projection driven from a decorator at the draft-store boundary through an app-scoped coordinator, with explicit lifecycle/orphan/duplicate/suppression rules. No rest timer, current-set cursor, or per-set timestamps exist today: Phase 1 derives current exercise deterministically and ships without rest; Phase 1B adds a Logger rest timer (absolute endsAt, system timer rendering); Phase 2 rest-only controls require an app-scoped session-authority refactor; Phase 3 remote push not recommended. APIs verified against the local iOS 27 SDK plus Apple docs/HIG/WWDC26. Independent of Sleep; Sleep's latest status remains in report 20261001T053235Z.

tests.summary: No code changed; plan includes a 52-item deterministic test plan and a 17-step physical-device acceptance checklist.

review.summary: Subagent audit claims spot-checked directly against source (draft store, view model, activeLiveSession, generator drift, verifier counts, upload appex check) and against SDK swiftinterfaces.

zero_write_audit.summary: Read-only production authority check only (deployment 8008f928, b81c784e, health ok).

decisions_required: D1 (blocking): which iPhone model/iOS will do physical acceptance (Dynamic Island availability).
D2: build the Logger rest timer (Phase 1B)? auto-start vs manual, default duration, end-of-rest notification.
D3: add optional per-set completedAt to the draft (recommended).
D4-D9: stale timeout, Lock Screen privacy toggle, Watch Smart Stack layout, font, Phase 2 rest controls, completion dismissal duration.
blockers: Project generator is missing three hand-added Sleep files present in the committed pbxproj; any regeneration would drop them. Sleep-lane owner must reconcile before Live Activities implementation.
verify_release_configuration.py requires CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION exactly twice; any extension needs a target-aware verifier update.
First provisioning of a new extension App ID via automatic signing is unproven; if Apple ID re-auth is needed the Founder must do it.
unexpected_findings: Generator/pbxproj drift: HealthKitSleepHistoricalEvidence Contracts/Presentation/Tests files are in the pbxproj but not in generate_project.py.
The physiqueos-audit doctl context returns 401; physiqueos-final-cutover-config still reads.
The in-app Workout Logger header shows a static 'Started now' regardless of elapsed time.
Multiple concurrent live drafts are allowed by design; 'active' is a derived selector, so the Live Activity must enforce at most one activity itself.
backlog: Phase 0: Sleep-lane generator reconciliation proving byte-identical regeneration.
Phase 1: local Live Activity per plan section 10 with tests 1-46 and 52.
Phase 1B: Logger rest timer authority + rest presentation.
Phase 2 (optional): TrainingSessionAuthority refactor, then Skip rest / +30 s LiveActivityIntents.
recommended_next_step: Founder answers D1-D9 (D1 blocking); Sleep lane reconciles the generator drift; then a new Claude Remote Control chat (Opus, high reasoning) implements Phase 1 only on a fresh Native worktree, followed by Codex adversarial review and a Founder-authorized TestFlight build for physical-device acceptance.
